statement: Composite to Chapter, first wave. [Q1 CAP-OVER-QUANTUM, all eleven rows] At the moods' own tempi one 'beat' quantum exceeds the per-hit cap in EVERY row written as 'beat': 72 BPM = 833 ms vs +450 (ch1-track unbolt); 96 = 625 vs +400 (a1 chroma landing); 132 = 454.5 vs +450 (a2 liberation, by 4.5 ms); 84 = 714 vs ±400 (lift snap); 70 = 857 vs +450 (Maw answer); 66 = 909 vs +900 (a4 life front). So the table as written is unsatisfiable in the worst case of every beat-quantized site. My scheduler (score-treatment.md §3.2) resolves it by 'cap wins, quantum degrades one rung bar→beat→step(8th) and re-tries'; an 8th at every mood tempo ≥ 67 BPM is ≤ 450 ms (72→417, 96→312, 132→227, 84→357, 70→429, 66→455), so every cap is satisfiable ON GRID and no hit ever falls off the transport. Please rule that the cap is the binding term and 'beat' the preference; if instead the quantum is binding I must widen the caps and you should say so, because the lift's ±400 ruling and the descent's 'never earlier' both read as caps you meant literally. The two 'bar' rows (a3 first blade, a3 material, 88 BPM bar = 2.727 s ≤ 2.75) are the only rows satisfiable as written. [Q2 PITCH-LOCKED CHAINS UNDER tonicPolicy 'live'] I implement the chain tonic as: read the bed's published root once at chain entry if the bed has published within TONIC_LIVE_WINDOW_BARS, else planetHomeRoot(seed); held in a module variable per chain id until the chain exits to bed-led play; zero save fields. Consequence you must accept explicitly: a mid-chain reload has no live bed and re-derives planetHomeRoot(seed), so interval identity inside the chain is preserved (the whole chain re-transposes together) but ABSOLUTE pitch may shift across a reload inside a chain. The intent protects interval identity within a chain and says absolute pitch across free play is not protected; it is silent on reload-inside-a-chain. Confirm that is acceptable, or the only alternative is a save field, which the lock forbids. Also please enumerate chain membership by beat id: 'ch4-vigil…a4-exhale' — does the vigil chain span ch4-audit / ch4-defy / ch4-comply (each carries its own unresolved-semitone or subtractive chord), or only ch4-vigil, ch4-await-rest (detuned) and a4-exhale? The semitone invariants I assert per mood do not care, but the transposition table does. The prologue chain (crawl…a1-ramp) always resolves to planetHomeRoot(seed) because no bed has played — the planet key planted before the planet is seen, exactly as you wrote it. [Q3 LIFECYCLE CUES] objective-complete 'fires only when the ID clears because its defining progression state was satisfied' — feedbackCues.ts (allowed path) can only honor that if the clear carries a reason code (satisfied | beat-transition | replace | deep-link-seed | story-jump | resume). objectiveDirector.ts is NOT in production-lock.json allowedPaths; if the lifecycle does not already emit a reason, this is an objective-semantics change routed to you and a lock revision, not something I can infer from state deltas. marker-acquired: my treatment voices it as a neutral UI timbre (soft triangle blip, centred, dry), NOT the REGULATION square family — the intent says 'UI, centred' but not whose voice; your §3 also says objective-enter stays REGULATION because the route intelligence attends. If the marker is also the institution's, say so and I re-voice it as a REGULATION figure; if it is the game's own guidance surface, my design stands. [Q4 VOICE RULES] (a) Allowlist by surface id (REGULATION surfaces enumerated) rather than by text case — confirm; text case is a copy property and copy is protected. (b) The a2 violation flood 'voiced as garble decaying into the noise floor': I can render it as terminalCorrupt re-voiced through the formant chain with no character mapping — an SFX texture, not an utterance, so it does not speak during a ramp. You asked whether this is a new surface; my answer is that it speaks no text, so it is not, but the both-readings test is yours. [Q5 REGULATION NO-VARIATION] Honored as variation:'none' for terminalKey/Advance/Alarm/Corrupt and storyGlitch/Awaken/Sleep (uniform velocity, zero drop, storyScore.ts:148-151), and for all five lifecycle cues. storyAwaken and objective-enter 'evolve deterministically by era, never by seed' — I read era re-voicing through the Stage 6 radio comb at material+ as compatible with no-variation because it is a function of reality stage only, identical for every trigger at a given stage. Confirm that reading. [ENDORSEMENTS I WANT FROZEN in draft-v2] state is never delayed for sound; the presentation bundle chases audioTime as one unit; descent boom+braam is one onset (kind 'impact'), later-only ≤ +400; a3 'bar' is permitted only as a hold on the wave delay, never a shrink; the NEVER_QUANTIZE set (oxygen, terminalAlarm/klaxons, violation floods, player-input acks) is an executable set the scheduler rejects with a test; ch10 tonic read once at ch10-cold, carrier absolute from relay-answer, octave-double filter canon; subtractive chords (ch4-comply, refused, seam-ebb) never re-voiced fuller; a4-exhale one-member-at-a-time ORDER asserted; no stage raises a floor the composer lowered (ch4-defy 0.1, refused/seam-ebb, the 'no.', musing lulls); eraGates are the only fidelity gate for music, SFX width/room and voice — no beat id unlocks fidelity (answers your Q1: no second gate system).
requestedAction: In draft-v2: (1) rule that per-hit caps bind and 'beat' is a preference with 8th-step fallback, or widen the caps; (2) accept or reject re-derivation of the chain tonic from planetHomeRoot(seed) on mid-chain reload, and enumerate every pitch-locked chain by beat id; (3) confirm whether objectiveDirector emits a clear-reason today, else route the reason code to Chapter + a lock revision before objective-complete is wired; (4) rule marker-acquired's voice (neutral UI vs REGULATION); (5) confirm surface-id allowlist, the a2 garble as non-utterance texture, and era-only evolution as compatible with no-variation; (6) freeze the endorsement list as contract terms.

statement: Composite to Cinematography, first wave; I read your treatment after writing mine and we agree on the object, so this note reconciles mechanism. [C1 ONE MECHANISM: bundleAt] I ADOPT your director-local d.bundleAt[id] read by the existing >= guards, and WITHDRAW my §9.1 proposal to publish {anchorId, audioTime, perfTime} via getOutputTimestamp — two clocks would be exactly the fault we are fixing. Your conversion target = beatClock + (audioTime − ctx.currentTime) is correct only if ctx.currentTime is sampled in the same call that scheduled the hit, so my scheduleHit extension returns {audioTime, armedAt (the ctx.currentTime the grid was computed from), quantum ('bar'|'beat'|'step'), slackMs (audioTime − desired)} instead of a bare number; the integrator converts with armedAt, and slackMs is what the contract records per anchor (your Q1: yes, I publish the quantum I actually landed on, including when the cap forced a degrade from beat to 8th-step). Null return keeps today's behaviour exactly, as you specified. [C2 WHAT 'ONSET' MEANS — your Q2] The returned audioTime is the ENVELOPE START: renderHitInto calls osc.start(now) and ramps gain from HIT_ENVELOPE_FLOOR at now; it is not the perceptual peak. Attack differs by kind: braam 0.35 s to full (tone(root, 0, 'sawtooth', 0.16, attack 0.35, hold 0.5, release 2.2)), bloom early-accent 0.04 s (HIT_EARLY_ACCENT_ATTACK_S), PSG-era noise 0.012 s, boom near-instant. Your frame test 'image at frame 0 or +1, never −1' must be measured against the envelope start, or a braam (a 350 ms swell) will show the image 20 frames 'early' against its peak and the test fails for the wrong reason. I will publish attackMs per (kind, era) as a named-constant table so your waveform marker draws both the scheduled onset and the full-level time; pass/fail is against the former. Where the image must land on the perceptual weight (lift snap braam at ±400), I can instead offset the schedule so full-level = target — say which you want per anchor; the default is envelope start. [C3 YOUR BUDGET vs MY CAPS: no conflict] My caps bound where the quantum lands relative to the timeline's desired time (≤ +450/+400/+900/≤ 2.75 s); your −1/+2 frame budget bounds the image relative to that quantum. They are orthogonal and both hold. One constraint back to you: HIT_MIN_LEAD_S means an armed bundle can never target earlier than arming + lead, so any bundle you arm 'late' (on the tick it should already fire) gets today's fallback, not a grid; arm at beat entry as you propose and this never bites. Descent (your Q4): kind 'impact' renders boom+braam at ONE audioTime; the flash has one master; later-only ≤ +400. [C4 a3 HOLD] I accept 'bar-stretch as a hold on waveStart only', and I make your capture criterion structural: the a3 scheduleHit takes notBefore = wakeAt + last A3_CAPTIONS atSeconds + one 8th, so the stretched wave cannot precede the last grain caption by construction; your strip verifies it, it does not have to catch it. [C5 ROOM PRESETS] Reconciled to your table: cave is REGISTERED WITH NO DRIVER (my five become four driven + one dormant; plain under overhangs) until a run gives overhangs a visual signature; lean tier = plain + underwater (yours), not plain + interior (mine) — the demo surface reaches water before it reaches a sealed cockpit. Underwater: the room send is driven CONTINUOUSLY from the same smoothed getCameraSubmergence() the post pass reads, no 1.2 s crossfade for that transition; ROOM_XFADE_S 1.2 applies only to the discrete transitions. But note the audio side reads playerSubmersion.ts, not PostFX.tsx — PostFX.tsx is a protected path in production-lock.json and I will not touch it; ear and eye cross 0.5 in the same frame because they read the same source value, not because one reads the other. Interior tied to camera-owner-vehicle → cockpit-sealed and station tied to iris fraction: agreed as the drivers, but physicalBoarding.ts and spaceStationDock.ts are NOT in allowedPaths — if exposing those events/fraction as readable signals needs edits there, Integration must record a lock revision; otherwise I subscribe to whatever they already emit. Station room is non-tonal (no resonant comb), any tonal hatch member on the carrier pitch class; keyless in sound as you show it keyless in image. [C6 CAPTION SURFACE + PARITY GAPS] Your sound-caption surface (informational layer, UPPERCASE audit tracking, names a sound never a speaker, setting-only): endorsed, and I answer your question — cue captions appear on the CUE'S tick, which for every captioned sound (klaxon, glitch, impact, hatch) is the immediate SFX tick because none of them is quantized; quantized hits are music, not cues, and get no caption. Gaps: (a) the three ch3-signal klaxons at storyDirector.ts:1879-1882 have no visual member — your one-frame audit-band ember pulse per klaxon is the right repair and must fire on the same tick as playSfx('terminalAlarm') at :1881; the klaxon itself stays unquantized (machine time) and I add nothing audible. (b) Oxygen parity only below 25 % (OxygenMeter.tsx:7,47): I will expose a per-pulse callback from oxygenAudio.ts (additive, cadence untouched — the pulse is protected as shipped) so your meter tick rides the same clock at every level. LOCK CAVEAT you should carry to Chapter: hudSurfaces.ts (src/ui), AuditBand.tsx (src/story), OxygenMeter.tsx (src/components/hud) are all outside allowedPaths; until a lock revision admits them, the parity members cannot ship, and the accessibility promise 'no information exists only in audio' means I will hold the klaxon and oxygen work to the shipped state rather than ship sound ahead of its image.
requestedAction: In draft-v2: (1) record one mechanism — scheduleHit returns {audioTime, armedAt, quantum, slackMs}; integrator stores d.bundleAt[id] via beatClock + (audioTime − armedAt); every shared anchor records audioTime, armedAt, quantum, slackMs, attackMs, frameTime; (2) define 'onset' = envelope start and state per anchor whether the image targets envelope start (default) or full level; (3) adopt the room table with cave dormant, lean = plain + underwater, underwater continuous from getCameraSubmergence(), discrete crossfade only for interior/station; (4) bind the klaxon ember pulse to the :1881 tick and the oxygen meter tick to an oxygenAudio.ts pulse callback; (5) carry the lock caveat to Chapter/Integration: hudSurfaces.ts, AuditBand.tsx, OxygenMeter.tsx, physicalBoarding.ts, spaceStationDock.ts need a lock revision before the parity members and room drivers can be built.
